findings.statement: CA9 protein is up in tumour vs normal (protein log2FC 2.269), with RNA and phospho layers concordant and top-2 in the convergence ranking; it replicates in TCGA-KIRC, survives purity extrapolation and has anti-CA9 antibody drugs (girentuximab).

NNMT protein is strongly up in tumours (protein log2FC 2.709), RNA concordant, replicated in TCGA-KIRC and prognostic there (higher expression, worse survival); top of the biomarker profile among up-regulated genes.

CD70 is a membrane target with protein up in tumours (protein log2FC 2.421), concordant RNA, TCGA replication and tumour-intrinsic signal after purity extrapolation; antibody and ADC agents (cusatuzumab, vorsetuzumab) exist.

ENPP3 is a surface enzyme up at protein level (protein log2FC 1.544) with concordant RNA and TCGA replication; the ADC AGS-16C3F reached phase 2. Frequent copy-number loss is noted, so it is not a dosage-driven gain.

SCARB1 (HDL receptor) ranks first in the target profile; protein is up (protein log2FC 1.837) with concordant RNA and strong TCGA replication, but it has no DepMap dependency and no prognostic signal, so it is a tumour-selective but not essential candidate.

SLC16A3 (MCT4 lactate exporter) is up at protein level (protein log2FC 2.279) with concordant RNA, TCGA replication and tumour-intrinsic expression, consistent with the glycolytic phenotype of VHL-null ccRCC.

PSAT1 is down in tumours (protein log2FC -1.963) with RNA concordant, and it leads the biomarker profile; low expression is associated with worse survival in TCGA-KIRC. Reflects loss of normal tubule metabolism, so a biomarker rather than a target.

PCK1 (gluconeogenesis) is down in tumours (protein log2FC -1.859) with concordant RNA loss and TCGA replication; high expression is associated with better survival. A tubule-identity biomarker, not a target.

ALDH6A1 is down in tumours (protein log2FC -1.925) with concordant RNA, frequent copy-number loss and a positive cis copy-number effect on expression, consistent with 3p/5q-linked dosage loss; strongly prognostic in TCGA-KIRC (higher expression, better survival).

VWF is up in tumours (protein log2FC 1.284), reflecting the vascular-rich ccRCC phenotype; the signal is partly endothelial, and VWF is approved-drug tractable (caplacizumab) but is a tissue-context biomarker rather than a tumour-cell target.

caveats: Each finding cites a single protein-layer DE record for its quantitative claim; RNA, phospho, TCGA, purity and CNV statements are qualitative summaries of the convergence ranking rows.
DepMap effects are near zero for the top up-regulated genes, so none shows a selective dependency; target status rests on tumour-selective expression and tractability.
CPTAC discovery cohort is 110 tumours with 75 RNA and 84 proteome normals; bulk tissue includes stroma and immune cells (e.g. VWF).
Phospho layer values are gene-level and not protein-adjusted; kinase activity and site-level analyses were not queried in this run.
Passing automatic checks does not constitute complete scientific validation.
